FRED_API_KEY.description: A required FRED API Version 2 key. It is sent only in the HTTPS Authorization header and is never written to notes, recipe state, or generated files.

FILTER_FILE.description: An optional Markdown checklist selecting economic indicators and history depth. Checked items are included and unchecked items are ignored. When unset or empty, the recipe uses its documented default indicator set and the latest two observations.
